item.description:
Lexo 1.2.9

  • 🚀 Launch at login, your call. On a new installation, Lexo no longer adds itself to your login items without asking: the welcome guide now offers it with a checkbox, checked by default. If you already use Lexo, your setting is unchanged, and you can still change it in Preferences → General.
  • 🔒 Privacy policy. A link in Preferences → About now opens Lexo's privacy policy, in English, French or Spanish.
  • 🙏 Acknowledgments. Preferences → About now credits Sparkle and KeyboardShortcuts, the open source projects Lexo builds on, and shows their licenses in full.

Lexo 1.2.8

  • 🖐️ The bubble can be moved again. On macOS 27, the translation bubble could no longer be dragged. Grab it by its header, its margins or its footer to move it; the text areas stay reserved for selecting text.

100% on-device · your text never leaves your Mac · no account.

Lexo 1.2.9

  • 🚀 Lancement à l'ouverture de session : à toi de choisir. Lors d'une nouvelle installation, Lexo ne s'ajoute plus aux éléments d'ouverture sans rien demander : le guide de bienvenue le propose avec une case, cochée par défaut. Si tu utilises déjà Lexo, ton réglage ne change pas, et il reste modifiable dans Préférences → Général.
  • 🔒 Politique de confidentialité. Un lien dans Préférences → À propos ouvre la politique de confidentialité de Lexo, en français, en anglais ou en espagnol.
  • 🙏 Remerciements. Préférences → À propos cite désormais Sparkle et KeyboardShortcuts, les logiciels libres sur lesquels Lexo s'appuie, et affiche leurs licences en entier.

Lexo 1.2.8

  • 🖐️ La bulle se déplace de nouveau. Sous macOS 27, la bulle de traduction ne pouvait plus être déplacée. Attrape-la par son en-tête, ses marges ou son pied pour la déplacer ; les zones de texte restent réservées à la sélection du texte.

100 % local · tes textes ne quittent jamais ton Mac · aucun compte.

Lexo 1.2.8

  • 🖐️ The bubble can be moved again. On macOS 27, the translation bubble could no longer be dragged. Grab it by its header, its margins or its footer to move it; the text areas stay reserved for selecting text.

Lexo 1.2.7

  • 🗂️ History you control. A new switch in Preferences → History turns it off entirely, which also erases what was already saved. Or keep it and choose how long: 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days or forever.
  • ⚡ Faster capture. Lexo no longer waits a fixed delay after copying your selection: the bubble appears as soon as the app has copied it, and Lexo stays responsive meanwhile.
  • 📋 Your clipboard left alone. When nothing is selected, your clipboard is not touched at all, and clipboard managers no longer record a duplicate of your last item.
  • 💬 Clearer messages. "Downloading model" only shows when a model is really being downloaded, and text whose language can't be detected now says so plainly.
  • 🔊 Better voices. Read aloud now picks a voice from your region (US or UK English, Brazilian or European Portuguese) and a Taiwanese voice for Traditional Chinese.

100% on-device · your text never leaves your Mac · no account.

  • ⚡ Faster capture. Lexo no longer waits a fixed delay after copying your selection: the bubble appears as soon as the app has copied it, and Lexo stays responsive meanwhile.
  • 📋 Your clipboard left alone. When nothing is selected, your clipboard is not touched at all, and clipboard managers no longer record a duplicate of your last item.
  • 💬 Clearer messages. "Downloading model" only shows when a model is really being downloaded, and text whose language can't be detected now says so plainly.
  • 🔊 Better voices. Read aloud now picks a voice from your region (US or UK English, Brazilian or European Portuguese) and a Taiwanese voice for Traditional Chinese.

Lexo 1.2.6

  • 🔎 Windows now come to the front. Checking for updates from the menu bar opened Sparkle's window behind the app you were using, so the click seemed to do nothing. The Preferences window had the same flaw. Recent macOS versions refuse to bring a background app forward, so Lexo now raises its windows directly instead of asking to be activated.

100% on-device · your text never leaves your Mac · no account.
